files.summary: FastAPI application entry point. Registers 40+ routers, starts RSS/email/amendment schedulers on startup, connects to MCP Toolbox.
Pydantic Settings class loading all env vars: Supabase, AI keys (Mistral/Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini), Stripe (18 price IDs), SMTP, Tavily, TED API, HuggingFace, Google/LinkedIn OAuth.
SQLAlchemy engine/session setup. NullPool in production (serverless), connection pooling in development. Provides get_db dependency.
Supabase client initialization with anon key (frontend-safe) and service role key (admin ops). Used for auth, storage, and realtime.
Main chat API with streaming SSE support. POST /message for sync, POST /stream for SSE. Handles pre-user anonymous chats, MEP name linking, background message persistence.
Authentication endpoints: email/password signup/login, Google OAuth, LinkedIn OAuth, JWT token management, profile updates, pre-user chat linking.
Development mode auth bypass. Creates test user with blue tier when DEVELOPMENT_MODE=true and no JWT provided.
Admin authorization dependency. Checks user.role == 'admin'. Only hello@beresol.eu has admin access.
Document generation API: position papers, MEP briefings, talking points, resolutions, EP questions. Saves generated docs to user_documents.
EU Calendar endpoints with tier-gated access. Yellow+ for read, Blue for AI summary/sync trigger. Supports EP, Council, Commission, ECB events.
Stripe integration: checkout session creation, customer portal, webhook handler. Maps 18 price IDs to internal yellow/blue tiers.
Subscription management: tier listing, plan details, usage stats, feature access checks. Three tiers: white/yellow/blue.
Largest API file. Legislative Train CRUD, search, scraping, OEIL/EUR-Lex sync, document gateway, timeline, carriage tracking. 24+ endpoints.
My EU Bubble RSS aggregator: feed management, entry reading/saving, digest generation, AI enrichment, batch operations. 21+ endpoints.
EU Tenderator: tender search/browse, profile-based matching, SME analysis, requirement extraction, bookmarking. 19+ endpoints.
Legislative prediction API: timeline, outcome, cohesion, committee, council QMV, delegation analysis. Tier-gated (yellow/blue). 17 endpoints.
Amendator API: CRUD amendments, AI generation/analysis/explanation, EUR-Lex legislation fetching, comparison view. 12 endpoints.
EU Law Comply: law cluster browsing, requirement extraction, compliance gap analysis, report export. Searches 28K+ EU laws.
EC Public Consultations: browse, track, AI analysis, input generation, impact assessment. 13 endpoints.
Document upload (PDF/DOCX) and EUR-Lex document fetching. Parses legislation into articles/recitals for Amendator.
Admin panel: user CRUD, feed management, system stats, scraper status/trigger, re-engagement email campaigns. 13 endpoints.
Admin analytics dashboard: user stats, conversation metrics, quality scoring, data export.
Admin tender management: CRUD, fetch from TED, SPARQL analytics, matching, notifications, settings.
Admin EU compliance: cluster stats, requirement extraction (AI + HF models), vector index building, semantic search.
RSS feed API: CRUD feeds, entry browsing/search, institutional filtering, AI enrichment (on-demand), manual refresh.
MEP amendment tracking: sync from EP, search, comparison analysis, alignment scoring against user position.
EP Committee Work in Progress: 26 committees tracked, items CRUD, sync from EP, user tracking.
EP Texts Adopted: browse, search, sync from EP website, user tracking.
Commission documents: browse, search, sync from EC Register, individual doc lookup, user tracking.
EPRS publications API: browse, search, sync from RSS/Think Tank. Chatbot-only (no UI tab).
User feedback system: submit, view, admin CRUD, comments, stats, chat-specific feedback.
Data export API: documents CSV, reading list CSV, analytics JSON, full data export.
Notification API: list, unread count, mark read, delete.
Personalisation API: returns time-of-day greeting with user's preferred name and timezone.
EP committee reference data API: list all 26 committees, details, member scraping, search.
Legislative tracking: track by CELEX or procedure ref, view tracked items, status changes, progress summary.
EU data browsing: priorities, legislative files, search, tracking. Alternative view of legislative train data.
User documents CRUD: create, list, search, filter by type/procedure. Stores position papers, briefings, etc.
User preferences and tour progress management. Stored in users.preferences JSONB column.
DG GROW databases: notified bodies (NANDO), technical regulations (TRIS), trade barriers (TBT), industrial ecosystems.
Cron job endpoints called by Railway scheduler. OEIL sync (6h), EUR-Lex sync (6h), full sync, daily brief generation.
Daily EU brief API: today's headlines (public, no auth), stats, unsubscribe HTML page.
Chat example prompts: public fetch for chat UI, admin CRUD. Scope-based (main_chat, etc.).
Pre-user analytics: track anonymous events, email captures, conversion funnel for admin.
Catalan translation catalog API: browse, search by CELEX, stats. Public endpoints.
Core AI service: Claude Sonnet 4 primary, multi-provider fallback. EU context injection, streaming, MEP name linking, citation tracking, system prompts, knowledge gap logging.

Second-largest file. Builds comprehensive EU context for AI chat. Semantic search, entity extraction (CELEX/procedures/MEPs), live API calls, knowledge guide matching, RSS updates, legislative train enrichment, Tavily web search fallback.
Multi-provider AI with automatic fallback chain: Mistral -> Claude -> GPT-4 -> Gemini. Abstract provider interface with standardised response.
AI document generator: position papers, MEP briefings, talking points, resolutions, EP questions. EU advocacy style guidelines, British English.
Computes follow-up action buttons (available_actions) from context data for chat UI. Generates links to OEIL, EUR-Lex, Document Gateway.
Conversation memory service: tracks topics discussed, entities mentioned, user preferences across chat sessions.
Detects if user query requires fresh/current data vs historical knowledge. Triggers Tavily search for real-time needs.
Provides tender-specific context for AI chat. Detects tender intent, fetches relevant tenders/matches from DB.
Hybrid legal assistant combining Saul-7B (legal LLM) with Claude. Currently disabled due to API hangs.
Multi-document RAG service: retrieves and synthesises information across multiple uploaded documents.
Gmail SMTP email service: send individual and BCC batch emails. Used for re-engagement, campaigns, daily briefs.
Daily brief email generation and BCC batch sending. 5 headlines with Ask Brubru CTAs, dynamic feature line, unsubscribe link.
MCP Toolbox wrapper: connects to GenAI Toolbox server for SQL-based AI tools. Graceful degradation if unavailable.
Full-text search across 28K+ EU laws using PostgreSQL TSVECTOR. Ranked search with policy area, doc type, year filters.
Personalised greeting generator: time-of-day, holiday detection (Christmas, Easter, Sant Jordi), user timezone support.
Notification service: create, read, mark-read, delete. Supports user-specific and broadcast notifications.
Data export service: generates CSV, JSON, text exports for user documents, reading lists, analytics.
Legislative tracking service: tracks legislation by CELEX or procedure ref, detects status changes.
Weekly re-engagement email scheduler using APScheduler. Identifies inactive users and sends nudge emails.
Tavily web search client: real-time search for EU policy news, statements, stakeholder info. Complements institutional databases.
OEIL client: procedure tracking, document status/timeline, XML feed parsing, individual procedure lookup by scraping.
EUR-Lex client: Cellar API for document content, SPARQL for metadata queries, RSS for latest publications.
EP client: MEP data, committee membership, plenary calendar, votes, amendments. Largest API client.
EP plenary debate transcript client: fetches/parses CRE XML from Doceo. 3-5 day publication delay.
EC document register client: individual doc lookup works (browser-like headers), paginated search returns 503.
EC public consultation client: scrapes Have Your Say portal for open/closed consultations.
Web scraper for EP Legislative Train. Unified method combines train/theme and package views (~500+ files with OEIL refs).
EU Calendar sync coordinator: syncs events from EP, Council, Commission, ECB into unified calendar table.
OEIL sync service: syncs legislative procedure data from OEIL XML feeds into legislative_carriages table.
EUR-Lex sync service: syncs latest EU legislation from RSS feeds, matches with legislative carriages.
EPRS sync: metadata from RSS, optional PDF enrichment with CPU-only embeddings (15+ min). Two-pass search for chatbot context.
Committee work sync: scrapes 26 EP committee work-in-progress pages, upserts into DB.
Consultation sync: scrapes EC Have Your Say portal, upserts open/closed consultations into DB.
Commission document sync: fetches from EC Register, dual strategy (EUR-Lex RSS + RegDoc API).
EP Texts Adopted sync: scrapes adopted text pages, upserts into DB.
Largest file. Loads 120 knowledge guides with 3,767 keyword triggers. Two-pass search matching, guide ranking by query-word density, freshness detection. GUIDE_KEYWORD_TRIGGERS dict is ~5000 lines.
Loads Beresol Knowledge Bundle: 11 open reports + 7 monitors. Always cited as 'Beresol Open Report/Monitor'.
Reference data loader: EC DG organigrammes (35 DGs), institutional structure, staff contacts.
Static reference data for 26 EP committees: codes, full names, key info. Used across chat, context builder, committee API.
Static reference data for EC DGs and policy areas. Used in consultation context building.
EU calendar institution/policy area reference data for frontend display and event classification.
EP parliamentary questions reference guide: types, rules, procedures for question generation.
User model: email, name, org, role (user/admin), OAuth, personalisation, subscription tier (white/yellow/blue), Stripe IDs.
Chat and Message models: conversation threads with token usage, model tracking, citations JSONB, pre-user support.
Legislative train models: trains (EC priorities), packages (thematic), carriages (files), status history, user tracking.
EU law models: 28K+ laws with TSVECTOR search, law clusters for compliance, extracted requirements.
Tenderator models: tenders, user profiles for matching, matches, fetch job tracking, settings.
EU Calendar models: events from 6 sources (EP, Council, Commission, ECB, CoR, EESC), user subscriptions with reminders.
EP voting data models: political groups, MEPs, votes, member votes. From HowTheyVote import.
EP resolution models: resolutions, MEP votes, resolution-to-legislation links, Commission followups.
Council voting models: 27 member states, governments, parties, ministers, statements, positions, national parliament votes.
Compliance models: analyses, gap findings, corrective actions, requirement vector embeddings, export records.
DG GROW models: NANDO notified bodies, TRIS regulations, TBT trade barriers, industrial ecosystems.
MEP amendment models: amendment documents (PDF sources) and individual amendments with MEP/group data.
Public consultation models: consultations, documents, user tracking, user inputs (AI proposals), status history.
RSS feed model: URL, source institution, category, last fetch time, error tracking.
RSS entry model: title, content, AI enrichment data (summary, topics, policy areas), publication date.
Daily brief model: headline, URL, source, category, snippet, suggested_query, publication date.
Catalan translation model: CELEX number, title, engine used, word count, translation status.
Pre-user event tracking: anonymous page views, chat interactions, email captures before signup.
Organisation intelligence model: user org data for personalised AI context.
Catalan EU legislation translation pipeline. Parses Formex V4 XML, translates via Softcatala NMT or Claude, generates standalone HTML.
CLI to send daily brief: --test (to Victor), --send (to all subscribers), --list, --verify-urls. URL verification blocks send on failures.
News alert emails to EU Transparency Register orgs. Classifies headlines into 12 policy clusters, BCC batch sends to matching orgs.
Lobby campaign email sender: 12 multilingual templates for policy clusters, BCC batching. Reads from CSV recipient lists.
Daily brief CLI: --test, --send, --list, --verify-urls. Sends brubrufied EU headlines to subscribers.
Seeds 13 test users: 5 Professional/Blue tier + 8 Starter/Yellow tier. Password: test123 (except Meritxell: test23).
Generates guides HTML landing page from knowledge base. Must be regenerated after any guide changes.
CLI to sync EU calendar events from all sources.
CLI to sync OEIL XML feeds into legislative carriages.
CLI to sync EUR-Lex RSS feeds.
CLI to sync EPRS publications. --enrich flag downloads PDFs + runs embeddings (15+ min).
CLI to sync committee work items from 26 EP committees.
CLI to sync public consultations from EC Have Your Say.
ML-based legislative outcome predictor: uses extracted features to predict pass/fail probabilities.
EU Council Qualified Majority Voting calculator: 55% of states + 65% of population thresholds.
Legislative timeline predictor: estimates days remaining based on historical progression patterns.
Core tender service: CRUD, search, filtering, profile-based matching algorithm.
TED API client: fetches public procurement notices from EU Tenders Electronic Daily.
TED SPARQL client: semantic queries on EU procurement data for analytics and historical search.
eForms XML parser: parses 51 EU procurement notice subtypes into structured data.
EUR-Lex document parser: handles OJ format (adopted legislation) and COM format (proposals). Auto-detects, extracts articles/recitals.
Formex V4 XML parser: extracts structured legislative text from EU Publications Office format.
RSS feed aggregator: fetches and parses feeds from EP, Council, Commission, agencies. Deduplication, error tracking.
RSS entry processor: on-demand AI enrichment (summary, topics, policy areas). enable_ai_enrichment=False by default.
APScheduler-based RSS feed refresh scheduler. Runs on application startup.
EU law compliance gap analyser: compares organisation practices against EU requirements, generates findings + actions.
ChromaDB vector store: manages collections for semantic search across EU documents, EPRS, knowledge base.
HowTheyVote.eu data importer: EP political groups, members, votes, resolutions. Supports incremental updates.
EP web scraper: committee members, plenary sessions, debates, votes. Used for MEP data enrichment.
EPRS Think Tank scraper: publications, briefings, at-a-glance notes. Extracts metadata and PDF links.
Commission College + Official Journal scraper: monitors new EU legislation publications.
DG GROW sync coordinator: orchestrates scraping from 4 EU databases (NANDO, TRIS, TBT, EMI).
Alternative startup script for production (Cloud Run). Reads PORT from env, starts uvicorn.
APScheduler for daily EP amendment data sync from Open Data API.
CLI to trigger cron sync endpoints on the backend API. Used by Railway cron service.
CLI to trigger daily brief generation via cron endpoint.
Scrapes email addresses from EU institutions: EP, Council, Commission, agencies. Outputs CSV for campaign use.
Scrapes lobby organisation emails from EU Transparency Register.
Imports 28K EU laws from LEG_2025-11 Formex XML corpus into eu_laws table.
CLI to import HowTheyVote.eu EP voting data.
Backfills eu_laws table with new schema columns (doc_type, policy_area, year, etc.).
Fixes 11K incorrect CELEX numbers in eu_laws table. Part of Great Regulatory Scan Phase 1.
Normalizes doc_type field across 28K eu_laws entries. Part of Great Regulatory Scan.
Final classification of 3,689 remaining unclassified EU laws. Part of Great Regulatory Scan.
Delta import for corpus updates. SHA-256 content hash comparison to detect new/changed laws.
Exports eu_laws table to CSV for analysis.
Health check script: tests DB connection, API endpoints, AI providers, RSS feeds.
Aggregates organisation intelligence from user data for personalised AI context.
Standalone EU news scraper for /news skill. Scrapes Commission OJ, LPP, PV, EP agendas, Council meetings.
Seeds 15+ EU institutional RSS feeds into rss_feeds table.
Batch Catalan translation: processes multiple XML files with progress logging, incremental saves, auto-caffeinate.
Imports completed Catalan translations into DB catalog.
Cleans bounced email addresses from pre_user_events to maintain email deliverability.

eu_institutional_apis: OEIL Legislative Observatory (XML feeds + web scraping)
